scope.evaluation_protocol: v3-category split: settings selected on 5 validation categories and reported on 10 held-out categories
scope.important_scope_note: These are benchmark results, not results from the APD EV-panel dataset or a production deployment.

frozen_complete_pipeline.architecture: Stage A recipe-based logical inspection fused with Stage B DINOv2 visual-reference matching and CLIP semantic scoring
frozen_complete_pipeline.threshold_protocol: threshold selected from disjoint validation normals at a 5% false-reject-rate target

final_fused_macro_metrics.interpretation: The system strongly separates normal and anomalous images and accurately localizes anomalous pixels on the held-out benchmark. AU-PRO is evaluated only up to a 5% false-positive rate and is normalized to the range [0, 1].

branch_comparison_macro_image_auroc.interpretation: DINO reference matching provides most of the benchmark performance; fusion gives the best final image-level result. Stage A is intended for fixed-layout logical assembly checks and is not a standalone MVTec surface-defect detector.

per_category_fused_results.note: Primary benchmark weakness: localization is excellent, but image-level rejection and calibration are comparatively weak.
Strong result with a small test set; interpret with wider uncertainty.

few_shot_dino_scaling.metric_scope: macro average over the same 10 held-out MVTec AD categories
few_shot_dino_scaling.interpretation: More normal reference images improve the visual matching branch. The deployed frozen setting uses k=4 as the validation-selected accuracy/operational-cost point.

operational_measurements.device_target: NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 8 GB VRAM
operational_measurements.interpretation: The measured 1080p memory footprint is well below the 7 GB deployment gate.

limitations_and_next_validation.reason: The APD dataset is not present locally, its ROI recipe has not been human-drawn and frozen, and no phase_6_apd_summary.json exists.
limitations_and_next_validation.do_not_claim: Do not describe these MVTec metrics as EV-panel, APD, customer-site, or production accuracy.
next_steps: Obtain APD through its official release terms and place it outside version control.
Draw and human-review ROIs using normal reference images only, then freeze the APD recipe.
Run the frozen Phase 6 APD protocol and the post-freeze ROI coverage check.
Investigate screw-category image-level scoring and calibration before a high-reliability deployment.
